# Multipart Body Part

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MultipartBodyPart`](gmeow-MultipartBodyPart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MultipartBodyPart>
- **Category:** class

A MIME container part that holds other body parts — the structural node of a multipart/alternative, multipart/mixed, multipart/related, or other multipart subtype. It is itself a [`BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md) and participates in the MIME tree via the universal [`hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md) / [`partOf`](../properties/gmeow-partOf.md) spine.
